```plato

    // Every cell split into two triangles: the collision and rendering faces
    // `Cloth3D` stores.
    GridTriangles(self: ClothGrid3D): Array<TriangleFace>
    {
        var columns = (self.ColumnCount - 1).Max(0);
        var rows = (self.RowCount - 1).Max(0);
        return (columns * rows * 2).MapRange(n =>
            self.GridTriangle(n / 2 % columns, n / 2 / columns, n % 2));
    }
```
